{{Short description|none}}
{{main|List of world records in swimming}}
The first '''world record in the men's 1500 metres [[freestyle swimming|freestyle]]''' in a [[long course]] (50 metres) [[swimming pool]] was recognised by the [[International Swimming Federation]] (FINA) in [[1908 in sports|1908]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Swimming World Record progression - Men 1500 m freestyle|url=http://multimedia.olympic.org/pdf/en_report_213.pdf|date=12 July 2002|publisher=[[International Olympic Committee]]|format=pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030418030353/http://multimedia.olympic.org/pdf/en_report_213.pdf|archive-date=18 April 2003}}</ref> In [[Short course (swimming)|short course]] (25 metres) pools, the world's governing body recognizes world records since March 3, 1991.
